name: PackedS4S8Dot16
adaptation: Sixteen signed two's-complement INT4 weights w[i] occupy bits 4*i; sixteen signed INT8 activations x[i] occupy bits 8*i. Return the signed INT32 result bias+sum(w[i]*x[i]), bias is signed INT16. No overflow is possible. Low nibble precedes high nibble; all sixteen products contribute. This is the packed-weight dot-product core, not a full requantized layer.
